description: This file contains functions for extracting graph representations from files, creating tensors from type information, loading and processing computation graphs, timing their execution on CPU or CUDA, running benchmarks with specific settings, and controlling JIT fusion strategies in PyTorch. It appears to be a utility script for working with TorchScript graphs and performance testing.

methods.name: list[str] extract_ir(filename: str)
methods.description: Extracts subgraphs in IR format from a file based on markers <GRAPH_EXPORT> and </GRAPH_EXPORT>.

methods.name: make_tensor_from_type(inp_type: torch._C.TensorType)
methods.description: Creates a tensor with the shape, stride, device, and dtype specified by a Torch _C.TensorType object.

methods.name: tuple[Any,list[Any]] load_graph_and_inputs(ir: str)
methods.description: Parses IR string into a TorchScript graph, generates sample inputs based on input types, and creates a callable function from the graph.

methods.name: time_cuda(fn, inputs, test_runs)
methods.description: Times execution of a function on CUDA with given inputs, returning median time in milliseconds.

methods.name: time_cpu(fn, inputs, test_runs)
methods.description: Times execution of a function on CPU with given inputs, returning average time in milliseconds.

methods.name: float run_test(ir, inputs, *, warmup_runs=10, test_runs=20)
methods.description: Runs the graph function multiple times with warmup, measuring execution time on CPU or CUDA depending on input device.

methods.name: no_fuser(*args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Context manager that disables JIT graph fusion within its scope.

methods.name: float run_baseline_no_fusion(ir, inputs)
methods.description: Runs the graph with fused operations disabled to measure baseline performance.

methods.name: float run_nnc(ir, inputs, dynamic)
methods.description: Runs graph with specific fusion strategy (dynamic or static) using NNC fuser.

methods.name: float run_nvfuser(ir, inputs)
methods.description: Runs graph with NV Fuser enabled for CUDA graph fusion.
